components.evidence: the purchases, sales and production bars are split into colour-coded regional segments within one bar
a `//` break glyph is drawn on the y axis between the 230 and 0 tick labels
bold `net -0.1 billion barrels of oil equivalent` printed inside the plot at the right
seven colour-matched region names stacked as text over the plot area between the sales and Latin America bars
thin horizontal rules at 270, 260, 250, 240, 230; no vertical rules
`Data source: Evaluate Energy` and `Note: Mergers and acquisitions between companies may affect net reserve changes...` below the plot

new_components.name: waterfall_connector_line
new_components.evidence: thin blue horizontal lines join the top of each bar to the base of the next bar
new_components.why_it_matters: 每个浮动条的数值必须由连接线给出的起点与条顶之差读出，而不是条顶的绝对刻度值。

new_components.name: floating_bars_off_baseline
new_components.evidence: the four step bars hang between 232 and 260, none touches the 0 baseline
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时须先确定条的底部高度，长度即变化量；直接读顶端会得到累计储量而非该步骤的增减。

new_components.name: signed_step_drawn_above_zero
new_components.evidence: sales and production are decreases yet drawn as positive-height bars above zero; only the callout shows a minus sign
new_components.why_it_matters: 负号无法从图形几何判断，必须依据类别名（sales、production）为读出的段长补上负号。

new_components.name: narrative_slide_title_above_figure_heading
new_components.evidence: large blue sentence `After net purchases and production... unchanged in 2024` above the bold figure heading
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题层级有两层：结论句与图表标题，表格上下文若只取一层会丢失单位或主题定位。

difficulty_notes: 轴上10个单位约占57像素，即1单位≈5.7像素。两端的总量条（232.5、232.4）5%容差达±11.6单位，几乎无法读错；但被打分的其余数值是地区堆叠段，量级只有1到8.5，5%容差分别只有0.05到0.43单位，即0.3到2.5像素——薄段（1.0、2.0、-3.0、-3.5）的边界本身在这一渲染下就有1到2像素的不确定性，加之瀑布条悬空、需先由连接线定底部再取段高，取值精度根本达不到。相比之下标签虽需“类别名+地区名”两键，且地区名以彩色文字置于图内而非图例，尚可在表头中承载。
